scenarios.mech: Final guidance preserves the proposed approach to developing locally applied steroid treatments for hemorrhoid symptoms.
Final guidance allows additional flexibility in development recommendations following discussions with sponsors and the academic community.

forecasts.notes: Draft guidance often takes years to finalize. Ten months have elapsed, but the discussion-oriented notice provides little information about substantive requirements or timing; the forecast relies heavily on process base rates.

scenarios.mech: Require reasonable, transparent charges for contractual breaches rather than an increment to the contracted interest rate.
Retain the charges framework while allowing a longer transition or narrower application to accommodate implementation concerns.
Combine stronger transparency requirements with flexibility in implementation timing or treatment of particular loan categories.

forecasts.notes: An explicit policy commitment, identified supervisory problems, and consultation closing two months ago favor adoption within six months. Implementation concessions are more likely than abandonment of the penal-charges principle.
missing: Full draft requirements and proposed implementation date

scenarios.mech: Require lending service providers aggregating multiple lenders to present offers transparently and support informed borrower comparisons.
Preserve comparison objectives while permitting flexibility in presentation, coverage, or transition arrangements.
Strengthen borrower-facing disclosures while narrowing selected operational requirements for aggregators.

forecasts.notes: Repeated policy commitment and a completed consultation support eventual adoption. Eight months since the comment deadline allow substantial processing time, but general regulatory timing remains variable and no publication timetable is supplied.
missing: Detailed draft display and comparison requirements

scenarios.mech: Finalize technical recommendations for demonstrating emergency-use injector reliability in BLA, NDA, and ANDA submissions.
Allow additional testing or analytical approaches while retaining the expectation of reliable delivery during life-threatening emergencies.

scenarios.s: Stronger critical-failure scrutiny with testing flexibility
scenarios.mech: Strengthen attention to failures preventing drug delivery while allowing flexibility elsewhere in reliability demonstrations.

forecasts.notes: The safety rationale and defined application pathways support eventual finalization. However, technical guidance commonly remains draft for years; fourteen months of elapsed time provides limited evidence of action within the next six months.
